custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with 4 on hand and a hyphen in its part number.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425728 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Have an active part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup has a part it must still offer.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425728 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, and descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds both.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728- and the descriptions start ZZAUTOTEST PL C425728 PART.
  • Have a received vendor bill, bill A, with one line for a vendor part.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-VENDORPART in Part Number and keep it as typed without picking a result, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive. On the Purchase Orders list click Receive on that purchase order's row; type any number in Vendor Invoice #, pick an Invoice Date, type 1 in Qty received, then click the Receive Parts button. The received bill is listed under Vendor Invoices in the left menu.
  • Start on bill A (Parts in the top bar, Vendor Invoices in the left menu, then bill A).
